description.en: MOSS voice design model: creates a speaker from a written instruction instead of a reference recording, then speaks the supplied text in that voice.
description.zh: MOSS 声音设计模型：以文字指令而非参考录音创建说话人，再用该音色朗读给定文本。

instruct.en: Voice description: timbre, age, pace, emotion.
instruct.zh: 音色描述：音质、年龄、节奏、情绪。

language.en: Optional full language name, such as English or Chinese; not an ISO language code.
language.zh: 可选的完整语言名称，例如英文或中文；不是 ISO 语言代码。

seed.en: Generation seed; later text chunks add their chunk index. Parsed as signed 32-bit integer then converted to uint32; negative values wrap.
seed.zh: 一代种子；后面的文本块添加它们的块索引。解析为有符号 32 位整数，然后转换为 uint32；负值换行。

temperature.en: Audio-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.
temperature.zh: 音频令牌采样温度。采样时必须是有限且正的。

top_p.zh: 音频令牌核心采样截止。

top_k.zh: 音频令牌 top-k 采样限制。

repetition_penalty.en: Audio-token repetition penalty. Must be finite and positive when history is nonempty.
repetition_penalty.zh: 音频令牌重复惩罚。当历史非空时，必须是有限且正的。

min_frames.en: Minimum generated audio frames per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based floor.
min_frames.zh: 每个文本分块生成音频帧的下限；非正值按文本长度推导下限。

max_frames.en: Generated audio-frame ceiling per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based ceiling. Runtime raises it to at least the effective min_frames plus the number of codebooks.
max_frames.zh: 每个文本分块生成音频帧上限；非正值按文本长度推导上限。运行时会提升到至少有效 min_frames 加 codebook 数。

text_temperature.en: Text-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.
text_temperature.zh: 文本 token 采样温度；采样时必须为有限正数。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum characters per generated text chunk; must be positive.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个生成文本分块的最大字符数；必须为正。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
